title: An OAuth-only HTTP MCP server (sentry) is reported as 'unauthorized (check its token)', but it has no token to check and kiln offers no way to sign in
observed: kiln defect (UX/parity). ~/.claude.json has sentry as {type:http, url:https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp}, with no headers or token (Claude Code signs in by OAuth). Startup shows '2 MCP servers unavailable · run /mcp'. /mcp lists '✕ sentry' with no reason on the list row; Enter shows 'failed: unauthorized (check its token) at https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp / connect: calling "initialize": sending "initialize": Unauthorized'. proxmox is explained well ('command not found: …/tsx'). The list hint 'Run kiln --debug to see error logs' is not actionable here.
expected: Claude Code marks such a server 'needs authentication' (src/components/mcp/MCPListPanel.tsx, src/cli/handlers/mcp.tsx '! Needs authentication') and offers to authenticate. kiln should at least say the server needs an OAuth sign-in that kiln does not support (or sign in once in Claude Code), not 'check its token'. Showing the short reason on the list row would save a keypress.
